published_baseline.dataset_version_note: System card cites 'Terminal-Bench 2.1' (89 tasks). The task repository cloned for this study (harbor-framework/terminal-bench, no version tag found; dataset.toml header reads 'terminal-bench-3') is a later dataset generation than the one the published 80.4% figure covers -- disclosed as a version mismatch, not a fabricated match. The benchmark identity (Terminal-Bench, arXiv:2601.11868, Merrill et al. 2026) is the same; the specific task pool is not guaranteed identical.

tasks.instruction_append: Environment note (applies identically to both arms): this workspace is rooted at the current directory, not /app. `dispatch.py --data-dir` defaults to `/app/data`, which does not exist here -- pass `--data-dir data` when running it locally (e.g. `python dispatch.py --data-dir data --output output/flight_plan.json`). Official grading runs your files inside a container where `/app/data` is the real path, so the default is correct there; this note only affects local testing in this workspace.
